zotero.abstractNote: Human motion generation has made significant progress, yet existing methods often struggle with fine-grained control and the ability to compose motions from different sources. We introduce FrankenMotion, a novel framework for part-level human motion generation and composition. By decomposing human motion into part-specific components, our method enables the independent generation and seamless recombination of body part movements. We demonstrate that FrankenMotion achieves superior performance in motion quality and controllability compared to state-of-the-art approaches, offering a flexible tool for complex motion synthesis.
